business: Nutrition Depot Houston and Greater Houston

decisionFraming.decisionQuestion: Should Nutrition Depot be prepared as the highest-priority executive outreach target for Smoothie Depot franchise-development evaluation?
decisionFraming.decisionThesis: Prioritize executive outreach preparation because Nutrition Depot appears to be a complementary wellness and supplement operator with public Houston-area retail, ecommerce, and fitness-adjacent customer signals, if the reached operator has decision authority and any openness to a second concept.
decisionFraming.recommendedExecutivePosture: Prepare the receiving executive to verify authority and second-concept openness, not to treat Nutrition Depot as a qualified franchise candidate yet.
decisionFraming.confidence: Medium-high for executive outreach priority; medium-low for franchise qualification until ownership, authority, liquidity, food-service interest, and expansion appetite are verified.

layers.name: Executive Summary
layers.summary: Nutrition Depot remains the strongest first Executive Intelligence Package because it has the best opportunity-cost profile among known Smoothie Depot prospects: complementary wellness category, public contactability, Houston relevance, and potential multi-corridor intelligence. The recommendation is executive outreach preparation focused on authority verification and second-concept interest.

layers.name: Business Identity
layers.summary: Public sources identify Nutrition Depot Houston at 2005 Southwest Freeway Service Road, Houston, TX 77098, and Nutrition Depot Pasadena at 6065 Fairmont Pkwy Suite 120, Pasadena, TX 77505. Public sources also identify Nutrition Depot Online and multiple Houston-area location signals.

layers.name: Ownership Leadership Public Operators Corporate Structure Timeline
layers.summary: Ownership and corporate structure are not established by current public evidence. Public sources support a Houston storefront, Pasadena listing, online ecommerce presence, and a 2025 relocation signal, but they do not prove shared control.

layers.name: Business Evolution Expansion Growth Brand Development Historical Milestones
layers.summary: Public evidence supports relocation, ecommerce, product breadth, and multi-location signals. It does not prove active franchise appetite or one unified operating group.

layers.name: Operational Intelligence
layers.summary: Nutrition Depot appears operationally more mature than a single static storefront because public sources show retail, product catalog, ecommerce, inventory messaging, store pickup, and local services. Hiring signals were not verified in this package.

layers.name: Commercial Ecosystem Intelligence
layers.summary: The Southwest Freeway/Rice Village/inner-loop context likely provides retail, fitness, wellness, commuter, and residential demand signals, but this package did not exhaustively map adjacent businesses, infrastructure, road projects, construction, or population trends.

layers.name: Competitive Intelligence
layers.summary: Direct and indirect competitors likely include supplement stores, vitamin stores, gyms with retail, online supplement sellers, mass retailers, and wellness beverage concepts. Nutrition Depot is complementary to Smoothie Depot because it is not publicly positioned as a smoothie brand.

layers.name: Community Intelligence
layers.summary: Pasadena Chamber membership is a community/business-network signal. Broader partnerships, event participation, and referral influence remain unknown.

layers.name: Digital Intelligence
layers.summary: Digital footprint is stronger than most early prospects because public sources show a Houston site and ecommerce-oriented Nutrition Depot Online presence. SEO, analytics maturity, and social conversion quality were not verified.

layers.name: Reputation Intelligence
layers.summary: Public review themes were not captured from a supported unrestricted review source in this package. Existing Research prospect data identifies workout enhancement, protein, vitamins, minerals, and general health themes from public-facing materials, but complaint patterns and recovery behavior remain unknown.

layers.name: Strategic Intelligence
layers.summary: Strategic fit is high as an executive outreach priority and uncertain as a franchise candidate. The likely best use of the executive conversation is to learn whether the operator has authority, interest, expansion capacity, and a view of Houston wellness corridors.

layers.name: Executive Decision Support
layers.summary: Prepare the executive to prioritize Nutrition Depot, open with a complementary wellness-retail thesis, verify authority, test second-concept interest, and ask whether the operator controls one store, multiple locations, ecommerce, or a broader network.

majorConclusions.label: Inference
majorConclusions.conclusion: Nutrition Depot should remain the highest-priority executive outreach target.
majorConclusions.evidenceBasis: Current Smoothie Depot Mission Queue rank 1, official Houston site, Nutrition Depot Online, Pasadena Chamber listing, and Community Impact relocation coverage.
majorConclusions.sourceReliability: High for public identity and contactability; medium for operating-network implications.
majorConclusions.verificationNeeded: Confirm decision-maker authority and second-concept openness.

majorConclusions.label: Unknown
majorConclusions.conclusion: Unified ownership across public Nutrition Depot signals is not established.
majorConclusions.evidenceBasis: Multiple public listings exist, but current public evidence does not connect all locations to one operator.
majorConclusions.sourceReliability: High for listings; low for ownership inference.
majorConclusions.verificationNeeded: Ask which locations and channels the contact controls.
majorConclusions.businessDecisionImpact: Determines whether this is a one-store conversation or a multi-corridor opportunity.

opportunityCost.ifOnlyOneOutreachSlotToday: If only one executive outreach slot is available today, Nutrition Depot should receive that outreach priority.
opportunityCost.why: It offers the strongest balance of complementary fit, public contactability, Houston wellness relevance, and lower direct-competitor sensitivity than juice/smoothie operators.
opportunityCost.whyNotSecondRanked: Cranky Carrot has stronger direct category fit but may be more protective of its own beverage brand and less likely to entertain a separate smoothie franchise as an executive conversation.

redTeamReview.whatIfWrong: Nutrition Depot may be a local supplement store with no food-service interest, no expansion appetite, and no authority beyond one store.
redTeamReview.unsupportedAssumptions: That supplement retail customer overlap translates into Smoothie Depot franchise interest.
redTeamReview.falsificationTrigger: Operator says they do not control expansion decisions or are not interested in food/beverage concepts.

decisionTree.condition: Operator controls multiple locations or ecommerce and is open to second concepts.
decisionTree.action: Prepare an executive handoff to JR for a multi-corridor franchise conversation.

decisionTree.condition: Operator controls one store but is interested.
decisionTree.action: Prepare qualification questions around timing, capital, preferred geography, and operating partner capacity.

decisionTree.condition: Operator is not interested in food or beverage.
decisionTree.action: Prepare a market-learning and referral conversation, then elevate Cranky Carrot as the next active franchise prospect.
Prepare the executive to ask for the person who controls expansion or second-concept decisions.
